summary.text: Linda Ujifusa is a Democratic state senator who has represented Rhode Island State Senate District 11 since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ujifusa was born in San Jose, California, and lives in Portsmouth, Rhode Island.
She earned a B.A., magna cum laude, from Harvard College and a J.D. from New York University School of Law.

Her career includes work as an attorney at Mintz Levin in Boston and in the superfund enforcement division of the U.S. EPA Office of Regional Counsel, and she taught legal writing at the University of California Hastings Law School.
Ujifusa was elected to the Portsmouth Town Council, where she was vice president from 2018 to 2022.
She founded the Rhode Island Healthcare Access & Affordability Partnership.
